# Fun Zone Tenerife — Things To Do in Tenerife
# https://funzonetenerife.com

> Fun Zone Tenerife is an online guide to the best things to do in Tenerife (Canary Islands, Spain): curated tours and activities across the island, our own self-guided outdoor escape games, and self-guided city audio tours. Content is available in six languages and covers the whole island. Perfect for travellers, couples, families and groups.

## Things To Do in Tenerife (curated activities)
A directory of the island's top tours and activities, bookable through our travel partners (GetYourGuide). Highlights include whale and dolphin watching, Mount Teide cable car and stargazing, Los Gigantes boat trips, jet ski and water sports, Siam Park and Loro Parque, quad and buggy tours, wine tasting and sunset catamaran cruises.
- Browse: https://funzonetenerife.com/en/activities

## Outdoor Escape Games (our own product)
Self-guided outdoor escape games (city games / street escapes) set in real Tenerife towns. Players use their own smartphones (BYOD) to solve GPS-triggered puzzles tied to real historical facts. No fixed time slot, played at your own pace on any day. An activation code is delivered by email after payment. Priced per phone/team (from 25€).

### Available Escape Games:
- **The Code of Ichasagua** — Los Cristianos & Montaña Guaza (3-4h, difficulty 3/5). Explore the Guanche civilization's last stronghold. Urban + mountain trail.
- **The Chest of Three Keys** — San Cristóbal de La Laguna, UNESCO World Heritage (2-2.5h, difficulty 4/5). Follow corsair Amaro Pargo's legacy through the historic city centre. Fully flat, accessible.
- **The Loot of La Batería** — Puerto de la Cruz (1.75h, difficulty 3/5). Track pirate treasure along the historic harbour and botanical gardens.
- **The Ashes of the Soul** — Garachico (2.75h, difficulty 5/5). Uncover volcanic history in a town destroyed and reborn from lava. Most popular.

### Escape Game Pricing:
- 1 phone (1 team): 25€
- 2 phones (2 teams): 35€
- 3 phones (3 teams): 45€

### Escape Game Technology:
- Geofencing / GPS-triggered narrative
- Self-guided (no game master needed)
- BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) — smartphone required
- Activation window after code redemption
- Activation code delivered by email after payment
- Book: https://funzonetenerife.com/en/escape-game

## City Audio Tours (Canary Islands)
Self-guided GPS audio tours of Canary Islands towns, narrated in your language, played offline at your own pace. Tenerife, Gran Canaria, Lanzarote and Fuerteventura cities, 12€ per activation code.
- Browse: https://funzonetenerife.com/en/canary-islands-audio-tour
- Canary Islands audio guide (Lume): https://funzonetenerife.com/en/audio-guide-canary-islands
